ModMetaData.name: Designations Tooltip
ModMetaData.author: CheaterEater
ModMetaData.description:
Drag-designation tooltips now show "X / Y" format: the number of cells actually affected X over the total area Y.
Mod settings (two checkboxes): - Classic mode: show only the affected count (just "X") instead of "X / Y". - Always show count on small drags: show the count even for small designations the base game normally hides.
